summary: The team is in full execution mode on the China Going-Global report launch and SEO-driven program prioritization, with the knowledge website redesign and social media agency selection as urgent blockers this week.
summaryDetail: The single biggest initiative is the 'New Chinese Playbook for Going Global' report, a joint CKGSB-IE project targeting a mid-September launch at Tech in Asia or Tyson events in Singapore. This week is critical: Felix must confirm the launch venue, the report translation and one-pager proposal are due, and op-ed contributors need to be secured. Simultaneously, the team has prioritized Asia Star and Intelligent China programs over US partnerships, with the Intelligent China webpage launching this week to drive traffic. The knowledge website redesign is stalled pending feedback on Joseph's alternative design, and the social media agency selection is urgent due to budget constraints—Media Minds is the preferred choice. On the operational side, the Outlook password lockout issue has been resolved by deleting and re-adding accounts, but all devices must be checked for old passwords. Upcoming: the SEO strategy to rank for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing will require a list of target search areas from Joseph, and the team will analyze Asia Star participant profiles to support program growth.
